name: signalk-routeiq
description: SignalK Nautical Route Planner - Offline tide and vessel-aware routing

scripts.build: tsc && tsc test/routing.test.ts test/navmesh.test.ts test/navmesh-integration.test.ts test/zeelandbrug.test.ts --outDir dist-test --moduleResolution node --module es2022 --target es2022 --declaration --declarationMap --sourceMap --esModuleInterop --strict --skipLibCheck

signalK.name: signalk-routeiq
signalK.description: Offline nautical route planner with tide and vessel-aware A* pathfinding

safetyMarginDraft.title: Draft Safety Margin (m)
safetyMarginDraft.description: Under-keel clearance added to design draft.

safetyMarginAirDraft.title: Air Draft Safety Margin (m)
safetyMarginAirDraft.description: Mast clearance added to design air draft.

safetyMarginBeam.title: Beam Safety Margin (m)
safetyMarginBeam.description: Width clearance added to design beam.

defaultCoastDistance.title: Default Min Coast Distance (NM)
defaultCoastDistance.description: Default minimum distance from coastline in nautical miles

fairwayMultiplier.title: Fairway Multiplier
fairwayMultiplier.description: Cost multiplier for fairway edges (lower = preferred)

openWaterMultiplier.title: Open Water Multiplier
openWaterMultiplier.description: Cost multiplier for open water edges (higher = less preferred)

wrongWayPenalty.title: Wrong Way Penalty
wrongWayPenalty.description: Penalty multiplier for traveling against traffic flow

routingBBoxMargin.title: Routing BBox Margin (degrees)
routingBBoxMargin.description: Initial search bounding-box margin around start/end

routingBBoxMaxExtent.title: Routing BBox Max Extent (degrees)
routingBBoxMaxExtent.description: Maximum bounding-box size before full graph fallback

lineOfSightSampleInterval.title: Line-of-Sight Sample Interval (m)
lineOfSightSampleInterval.description: Spacing between samples when checking line-of-sight for smoothing

lineOfSightSearchRadius.title: Line-of-Sight Search Radius (m)
lineOfSightSearchRadius.description: Radius to search for graph nodes when verifying line-of-sight

averageSpeedKnots.title: Average Speed (knots)
averageSpeedKnots.description: Average vessel speed used to estimate travel time
